Card.title: Credit Card
Card.description: A credit card entity with rewards and features.

name.description: The name of the credit card.

rewards.description: The primary rewards offered by the card.

fee.description: The annual fee for the card.

category.description: The category of the card (e.g., Travel, Dining).

isFeatured.description: Whether the card is featured on the home page.

updatedAt.description: The last time the card was updated.

Blog.title: Blog Post
Blog.description: A blog post entity for the credit journal.

id.description: Unique identifier for the blog post.

title.description: The title of the blog post.

excerpt.description: A short summary of the blog post.

category.description: The category of the blog post.

author.description: The author of the blog post.

image.description: URL to the blog post's image.

featured.description: Whether the blog post is featured.

updatedAt.description: The last time the blog post was updated.

Waitlist.title: Waitlist Entry
Waitlist.description: A user who has joined the VIP waitlist.

id.description: Unique identifier for the waitlist entry.

joinedAt.description: The time the user joined the waitlist.
